name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 H (SC1632)
sources: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 datasheet, release 5, build date 03/07/2026 (Figure 2 pinout, sections 3.1, 4.1, 5.1 to 5.8, ordering codes SC1631 and SC1632 at US$5.00 and US$6.00); RP2350 features as listed in that datasheet. Read 2026-10-07. Not measured on a board yet

columns.head: The chip: RP2350A
items: Two Arm Cortex-M33 or two Hazard3 RISC-V cores: pick when you build. Up to 150 MHz. The M33s have a floating-point unit
On a separate chip on the board (Winbond W25Q32RV), read through a 16 kB cache
Working memory. Sixteen times the MSPM0G3507's 32 kB: every model and demo in this project fits
A switching regulator on the board makes the 3.3 V. Pins are 3.3 V only

columns.head: Connections inside the chip
items: GP0 to GP22 and GP26 to GP28. GP25 is the green LED
Serial text. No USB serial chip on the board: the RP2350 does USB itself
Sensor bus / fast bus for displays
12-bit, 500,000 samples a second, three pins (GP26 to GP28). Its reference is the 3.3 V supply
Twelve tiny programmable state machines that make any timing protocol: WS2812 LEDs, VGA

columns.head: On the board, and missing
items: Micro-USB, BOOTSEL button, green LED, 3-pin SWD debug header, 4 MB flash
40 pins, fitted on the H version, breadboard friendly
No debug probe and no reset button: programs load by drag and drop while BOOTSEL is held
No AES block and no radio. It has SHA-256 hardware, a random-number generator and 8 kB of one-time memory
The one-time memory (OTP) cannot be undone: skip every example that writes it
